title: EXEMENTION
text: EXEMENTION, in Laws, a prings to be free from forms feriev or appearance : thus, barons and peers of the entire area, on account at their dipluity, corrupted from being thrown upon inquiry and insights, clergy-men, and others, from appearing as the Berliff's turn. Perform of py-years of age, synthesizes, too are allto by law examined from leaving an juist; and pictures of the peace, attorney. See: four earth offices.
